title: EventBridge: route integration events by meaning
outcome: Configure an explicit event bus/rule/target contract and debug a missing delivery.
useCase: AWS integrations and structured application-event routing.
drawbacks: Offering-specific contracts, per-entry failures, and target policies need attention.
version: AWS SDK for Ruby v3 · service-specific setup · no cloud resources created automatically
cue: Accepted entry → matched rule → delivered target → completed effect.

trace.title: Structured event
trace.detail: EventBridge connects event sources and targets with routing/filtering features. It is useful when you integrate AWS/service events or route application facts by a structured envelope. Choose the actual bus/pipe offering and its documented retention/ordering/replay behavior; newer offerings can differ from classic rule-based examples.

trace.title: Follow one item
trace.detail:
Application emits structured entry → event service accepts/rejects that entry → pattern matches → permitted target receives → consumer handles business effect. Debug one hop at a time with event/request identity.

If no target event appears, check producer entry result, bus/region/account, pattern field spelling/type, target permission, delivery retry/DLQ state, and consumer state.

trace.title: Try the failure
trace.detail: A successful batch API call can include failed entries. A pattern mismatch is different from a consumer crash. Bus products and ordering/replay features must not be generalized from an old diagram.
